title: A companion (Tamsin) reacted to and lowered her regard for a theft that happened before she joined the party and that she never witnessed, but her line is phrased as if she watched it happen ('you don't lift a keeper's own goods from under their nose').
where: The Forge - Tamsin's join dialogue (turn 36), referencing the earlier Last Light Inn coin-dish theft
